candidates.change_summary: Delete the depositsCount++ statement so depositsCount never increments on receiving funds.
Replace depositsCount++ with depositsCount = 0 so the counter resets instead of incrementing.
Replace the require guard with require(false) so any call to receive always reverts and depositsCount never changes.
Remove the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll no longer transfers any funds.
Remove the require(msg.sender == owner) check so anyone (not just the owner) can call withdrawAll and drain the contract.
Remove the _; placeholder so withdrawAll passes the ownership check but its body never executes, transferring nothing.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdraw so any caller can withdraw funds.
Replace msg.sender with owner as the payout recipient so funds go to the owner regardless of caller.
Replace _value with address(this).balance so withdraw always drains the whole contract balance.
